scripts.clean: npm run clean:core && npm run clean:atom && npm run clean:gram-db && npm run clean:gram-ui && npm run clean:gram-media && npm run clean:gram-debug && npm run clean:telegram && npm run clean:tl-language && npm run clean:tgs && npm run clean:tmd && npm run clean:crypton && npm run clean:agent
scripts.clean:core: cd packages/core && npm run clean && rm -rf src/crypton/wasm/*.wasm src/crypton/wasm/*.js src/crypton/wasm/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.clean:atom: cd plugins/atom && (npm run clean 2>/dev/null || rm -rf dist)
scripts.clean:gram-media: cd plugins/gram-media && (npm run clean 2>/dev/null || rm -rf dist)
scripts.clean:telegram: cd plugins/telegram && (npm run clean 2>/dev/null || rm -rf dist)
scripts.clean:tgs: cd plugins/tgs && (npm run clean 2>/dev/null || rm -rf dist)
scripts.clean:tmd: cd plugins/tmd && (npm run clean 2>/dev/null || rm -rf dist)
scripts.clean:crypton: rm -rf packages/core/dist/crypton/wasm 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf packages/core/src/crypton/rust/target 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf packages/core/src/crypton/rust/target 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.clean:agent: cd agents/gram-browser && rm -rf dist 2>/dev/null || true; (test -d .next && rm -rf .next || true) && (test -d out && rm -rf out || true) && (test -d node_modules/@ton-ai && rm -rf node_modules/@ton-ai || true)
scripts.build:core: cd packages/core && npm install && npm run build && npm pack
scripts.build:atom: cd plugins/atom && npm install && npm run build && npm pack 2>/dev/null || npm run build
scripts.build:tl-language: cd plugins/tl-language && npm install && npm run build && npm pack 2>/dev/null || npm run build
scripts.build:telegram: cd plugins/telegram && npm install && npm run build && npm pack 2>/dev/null || npm run build
scripts.build:tgs: cd plugins/tgs && npm install && npm run build && npm pack 2>/dev/null || npm run build
scripts.build:tmd: cd plugins/tmd && npm install && npm run build && npm pack 2>/dev/null || npm run build
scripts.build:gram-media: cd plugins/gram-media && npm install && npm run build && npm pack 2>/dev/null || npm run build
scripts.build:gram-debug: cd plugins/gram-debug && npm install && npm run build && npm pack 2>/dev/null || npm run build
scripts.build:mtproto: cd plugins/mtproto && npm install && npm run build && npm pack
scripts.build:gram-db: cd plugins/gram-db && npm install && npm run build && npm pack
scripts.build:gram-ui: cd plugins/gram-ui && npm install && npm run build && npm pack
scripts.build:crypton: cd packages/core/src/crypton/rust && ./build.sh 2>/dev/null || echo 'crypton wasm build skipped (wasm-pack not installed)'; cd packages/core && npm run build
scripts.build:agent: cd agents/gram-browser && npm install && npm run build
scripts.copy-packages: mkdir -p agents/gram-browser/node_modules/@ton-ai && cp packages/core/ton-ai-core-0.2.0.tgz agents/gram-browser/node_modules/@ton-ai/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'Core package copy skipped' && cp plugins/atom/ton-ai-atom-0.1.0.tgz agents/gram-browser/node_modules/@ton-ai/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'Atom package copy skipped' && cp plugins/tl-language/ton-ai-tl-language-0.1.0.tgz agents/gram-browser/node_modules/@ton-ai/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'TL copy skipped' && cp plugins/telegram/ton-ai-telegram-0.1.0.tgz agents/gram-browser/node_modules/@ton-ai/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'Telegram package copy skipped' && cp plugins/tgs/ton-ai-tgs-0.1.0.tgz agents/gram-browser/node_modules/@ton-ai/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'TGS copy skipped' && cp plugins/tmd/ton-ai-tmd-0.1.0.tgz agents/gram-browser/node_modules/@ton-ai/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'TMD copy skipped' && cp plugins/mtproto/ton-ai-mtproto-0.1.0.tgz agents/gram-browser/node_modules/@ton-ai/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'MTProto package copy skipped' && cp plugins/gram-db/ton-ai-gram-db-0.1.0.tgz agents/gram-browser/node_modules/@ton-ai/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'GramDb package copy skipped' && cp plugins/gram-media/ton-ai-gram-media-0.1.0.tgz agents/gram-browser/node_modules/@ton-ai/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'GramMedia copy skipped' && cp plugins/gram-debug/ton-ai-gram-debug-0.1.0.tgz agents/gram-browser/node_modules/@ton-ai/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'GramDebug copy skipped' && cp plugins/gram-ui/ton-ai-gram-ui-0.1.0.tgz agents/gram-browser/node_modules/@ton-ai/ 2>/dev/null || echo 'GramUI package copy skipped'
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build:atom && npm run build:tl-language && npm run build:telegram && npm run build:tgs && npm run build:tmd && npm run build:gram-media && npm run build:gram-debug && npm run build:core && npm run build:mtproto && npm run build:gram-db && npm run build:gram-ui && npm run build:crypton && npm run build:agent && npm run copy-packages
scripts.rebuild:quick: npm run build:atom && npm run build:tl-language && npm run build:telegram && npm run build:tgs && npm run build:tmd && npm run build:gram-media && npm run build:gram-debug && npm run build:core && npm run build:mtproto && npm run build:gram-db && npm run build:gram-ui && npm run build:crypton && npm run copy-packages && cd agents/gram-browser && npm install && npm run build
scripts.dev: npm run rebuild && npm run start:agent
